why: the init/fini pair for an rcl heap-built state or transition object. rcl models a state and a transition as heap objects carrying a malloc'd label string, built and torn down through init/fini pairs. Ours are `uint8_t` constants over the closed REP-2002 set (`RCLC_LIFECYCLE_STATE_*` / `RCLC_LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION_*`) with static labels, so there is nothing to construct or free. Constraint: no allocator -- `nros_platform_alloc` is the tree's only allocation route, and a label per state would put the state machine on the heap for no information gain.
